reference: Thirst is said to be worse than hunger on a long ride.
sk: O smäde sa hovorí, že je na dlhej jazde horší než hlad.
cz: O žízni se říká, že je na dlouhé jízdě horší než hlad.
acceptable: Thirst is said to be worse than hunger on a long {ride|drive|journey}.
On a long {ride|drive|journey} thirst is said to be worse than hunger.
It is said that thirst is worse than hunger on a long {ride|drive|journey}.
It is said that on a long {ride|drive|journey} thirst is worse than hunger.

mistakes.text: People say thirst is worse than hunger on a long ride.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Precvičuje sa Passive: „Thirst is said to be…“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Procvičuje se Passive: „Thirst is said to be…“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises the Passive: “Thirst is said to be…”.

mistakes.text: About thirst is said that it is worse than hunger on a long ride.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „O smäde sa hovorí“ sa neprekladá doslova: „Thirst is said to be…“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „O žízni se říká“ se nepřekládá doslova: „Thirst is said to be…“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Don't translate word for word: say “Thirst is said to be…”.

mistakes.text: Thirst is said that it is worse than hunger on a long ride.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po podmete s „is said“ nasleduje Infinitive, nie „that“: „is said to be“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po podmětu s „is said“ následuje Infinitive, ne „that“: „is said to be“.
mistakes.feedback_en: When the subject comes first, “is said” takes an Infinitive, not “that”: “is said to be”.

mistakes.text: Thirst is said being worse than hunger on a long ride.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „is said“ patrí Infinitive: „is said to be“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „is said“ patří Infinitive: „is said to be“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “is said” use the Infinitive: “is said to be”.

mistakes.text: Thirst is said to be more bad than hunger on a long ride.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Bad” has an irregular comparative: “worse”, not “more bad”.

mistakes.text: The thirst is said to be worse than the hunger on a long ride.
